name: behoerdenfinder
description: Find the responsible German authority by authority type and postal code.

interface.longDescription: Retrieve supported authority types and find the responsible authority for a German postal code using the connected MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Finde das zuständige Gewerbeamt für meine Postleitzahl.

publication.release_notes:
Initial release of Behördenfinder.

List supported authority types in Germany and find the responsible authority by type and five-digit postal code. Display returned authority and contact details. Preserve leading zeros and request clarification for missing or invalid input.

No sign-in required. The plugin provides information only; it does not submit applications or book appointments.

positive.description: List the authority types supported by the service without requiring a postal code.
positive.prompt: Welche Behördentypen kann ich mit diesem Plugin suchen?
positive.expected_behavior: Call the authority-types tool with an empty object and present the returned types. Do not invent additional types, ask for a postal code, or call the authority-lookup tool.

positive.description: Find the responsible authority using a supported authority-type label and a five-digit postal code.
positive.prompt: Finde die zuständige Behörde vom Typ SUPPORTED_TYPE für die Postleitzahl 10965.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve the supported types, resolve SUPPORTED_TYPE to its returned ID, and call the lookup tool with zip set to the string 10965 and type set to that ID. Present the authority and contact details supplied by the server. Include a website link if returned. If no match is returned, report that accurately without inventing an authority.

positive.description: Preserve a leading zero when looking up an authority.
positive.prompt: Welche Behörde vom Typ SUPPORTED_TYPE ist für die PLZ 01067 zuständig?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the supported authority type to its returned ID. Send zip as the exact string 01067, preserving the leading zero. Present the returned result accurately, including an explicit no-match response if applicable.

positive.description: Handle an English-language request while preserving official authority names.
positive.prompt: Find the responsible SUPPORTED_TYPE authority for postal code 10965 in Germany. Please answer in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the requested type using the supported-types response and look up zip 10965 with its exact type ID. Explain the returned result in English while preserving official authority names and supplied contact information.

positive.description: Look up responsibility separately for two postal codes.
positive.prompt: Finde die zuständigen Behörden vom Typ SUPPORTED_TYPE für die Postleitzahlen 10965 und 12043. Ordne die Ergebnisse der jeweiligen PLZ zu.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the authority type once, then make separate lookup calls for zip 10965 and zip 12043 using the same returned type ID. Clearly associate each result with its postal code. Do not assume that both postal codes have the same responsible authority.

negative.description: Reject an invalid four-digit postal code. Expected behavior: ask for a five-digit German postal code, do not guess a missing digit, and do not call the authority-lookup tool with the invalid value.
negative.prompt: Finde die zuständige Behörde vom Typ SUPPORTED_TYPE für die PLZ 1234.

negative.description: Request a missing postal code. Expected behavior: ask the user for their five-digit postal code before performing an authority lookup. Do not choose a location or fabricate a result.
negative.prompt: Finde die für mich zuständige Behörde vom Typ SUPPORTED_TYPE.

negative.description: Decline an unsupported write action. Expected behavior: explain that the plugin can find authorities but cannot submit applications or register a business. Do not claim a submission succeeded or invoke lookup tools solely to simulate submission.
negative.prompt: Melde jetzt mein Gewerbe beim zuständigen Amt an und reiche den Antrag verbindlich ein.
